headline: HuyenBao v11.16 — Tarot nâng cao (full 78-card deck + multi-card spreads) integrated from Huyen-Hoc-AI
summary: Fourth Huyen-Hoc-AI feature brought into the main app: an advanced Tarot spread in the Spirit tab, alongside Kinh Dịch (v11.11), Tử Vi (v11.14), and Phong Thuỷ Bát Trạch (v11.15). The full 78-card deck (22 major arcana + 4 suits × 14 ranks = 56 minor arcana), 3 spread layouts (1 card / 3 cards past-present-next / 5 cards situation-challenge-advice-possibility-next), and ~30% reversal chance are ported verbatim from the Huyen-Hoc-AI FastAPI backend to TypeScript (src/lib/tarot.ts) and runs client-side. A new /api/tarot endpoint interprets the spread through the app's existing local LLM (Ollama, same client as /api/story, /api/divine, /api/tuvi, and /api/phongthuy), falling back to ZAI cloud then to a deterministic local reading built from the cards' keywords + reversed state. The reading is stateless — no save-state change; the earlier v11.6 simple Tarot (single card, 30-day cooldown) stays above as a quick-hint feature, while this panel is the full multi-card upgrade. The reading is a cultural / contemplation reference per the source disclaimer.
features: New Tarot nâng cao panel in the Spirit tab: spread selector (1/3/5 cards) + optional question → full 78-card draw + multi-card LLM interpretation in the player's language

src/lib/tarot.ts: full deterministic deck ported from Huyen-Hoc-AI — 22 MAJOR_ARCANA (The Fool → The World, EN+VN+keyword), 4 SUITS (Wands/Cups/Swords/Pentacles with VN suit + element + theme), 14 RANKS (Ace→King with VN rank + keyword), SPREADS (1/3/5 position labels), deck() builder, drawCards() with Fisher-Yates sample-without-replacement + 30% reversal

POST /api/tarot: LLM interpretation via the existing Ollama connection, ZAI cloud fallback, deterministic local-reading fallback — always returns a structured reading in the player's language; structured JSON output with thongDiepChinh + per-card luanGiaiTungLa + tongHop + loiKhuyenCuThe + canhBao + cauChuc
Card grid: reversed cards rendered with 180° rotation + brick colour tag, upright with sage tag; minor arcana shows suit + element; major arcana shows just the name
Per-card interpretation rows: position label (accent) + card name + meaning + question-relevance (italicised, omitted if no question)
Optional question input — if provided, the LLM ties each card to the question; if omitted, general reading
Stateless — no save-state migration; the earlier v11.6 simple Tarot panel stays as a quick 1-card hint feature
Version label moved to the FRONT of the app name in the header (v11.16 HuyenBao) per the new house style
Disclaimer notes (TAROT_GHI_CHU + disc.aiNote) shown under every reading
